unprocessed_audit_items.summary: Nova IVC soundness via sonobe/folding-schemes library requires verification of library audit status and no known vulnerabilities.

counterexample.preconditions: Attacker finds vulnerability in sonobe folding-schemes library
attack_sequence: 1. Attacker crafts malformed intermediate proof
2. If Nova folding has soundness bug, invalid proof folds into valid accumulator
3. Final Groth16 proof passes on-chain verification despite invalid state transition
counterexample.expected_outcome: Invalid state transition accepted, enabling theft of funds

evidence.phase1_static: Analyzed zkp/src/nova/root_nova.rs. RootCircuit implements FCircuit trait from folding-schemes. generate_step_constraints at line 105-143. Uses relaxed R1CS for Nova folding. All 5 attack vectors analyzed.
evidence.phase2_counterexample_attempts: Tried: invalid intermediate proof (library-dependent), constraint bypass (R1CS enforced), accumulator corruption (library internal). Cannot verify library internals statically.
evidence.phase3_guard_search: Guard: folding-schemes library enforces relaxed R1CS constraints. FCircuit trait requires proper constraint generation. However, cannot verify library soundness through static analysis.
evidence.verification_required: Library audit verification. Requires: (1) Verify sonobe library version against known CVEs, (2) Review library audit reports, (3) Test invalid proof folding rejection.

counterexample.preconditions: Observer has access to multiple stealth addresses from same user
attack_sequence: 1. Observer collects stealth addresses from blockchain
2. If PoW difficulty is insufficient, observer can enumerate secrets
3. Observer links multiple stealth addresses to same identity
4. Privacy of user is compromised
counterexample.expected_outcome: Stealth addresses linkable to user identity

evidence.phase1_static: Analyzed zkp/src/circuits/burn_address.rs. compute_burn_address_from_secret at line 43-62. Uses poseidon3(domain, recipient, secret) with 'burn' domain separator. POW_DIFFICULTY enforced at line 47-56. ADDRESS_BIT_LENGTH truncation at line 58-61. All 5 attack vectors analyzed.
evidence.phase2_counterexample_attempts: Tried: PoW brute force (requires cryptanalysis of difficulty), Poseidon preimage (computationally infeasible), rainbow table (PoW prevents), timing attack (constant-time hash). Cannot verify unlinkability cryptographically without formal analysis.
evidence.phase3_guard_search: Guard: Domain separator 'burn' prevents cross-context attacks. PoW difficulty adds enumeration cost. Poseidon hash is one-way. However, linkability resistance requires formal cryptographic analysis.
evidence.verification_required: Cryptographic review. Requires: (1) Verify POW_DIFFICULTY provides sufficient enumeration cost, (2) Analyze Poseidon security margin, (3) Formal proof of unlinkability under stated assumptions.
